summary: AYTU BioPharma, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the mutual termination of its exclusive license agreement (Metadate Agreement) with Lannett Company, Inc., originally entered in 2022 and amended twice. The termination is effective June 23, 2026, via a Termination Agreement. AYTU may sell existing inventory and will continue royalty reporting/payments until sales cease; net revenue from Metadate CD for Q ended March 31, 2026 was only $49,000. No financial terms of the termination were disclosed, and the agreement's full text will be filed in the 10-K. No advisors or break fees mentioned. Watch for any litigation or impact on AYTU's product pipeline.
